title: NA takes no arguments, refuses any argument at entry, and always evaluates to #N/A
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, NA() takes zero arguments, rejects any supplied argument at formula entry (0x800A03EC), and returns the worksheet error #N/A. Its result is a value (not a reference or callable), so calling its result or passing NA() to a reference parameter is refused at entry; as a direct argument to worksheet functions it propagates #N/A.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0 build 20430 (1/1 pinned row, 2/2 full-bank rows), Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in dc_xrxb (row 51) and jnt_logical_info (row 170), and 3 entry probes in excel-entry.tsv.
